content: {"rules": ["Model forecasts exhibit significant mean-reversion bias, failing to capture sudden price spikes above 75 EUR.", "Sentiment scores above 0.67 consistently precede upward price movements that the model underestimates.", "The model lags in reacting to rapid price increases, showing a persistent downward bias during bullish trends.", "When sentiment drops to 0.00, the model incorrectly predicts stability instead of the subsequent price correction.", "Forecast overshoot occurs in the long-term tail, projecting gradual increases while actual prices decline.", "High sentiment values combined with recent price volatility require a correction factor to account for momentum.", "The model fails to anticipate the peak price of 76.67 EUR, indicating a structural underestimation of volatility.", "Sentiment history should be weighted more heavily when it shows consecutive high values to improve spike prediction."]}
